issues.description: The Person entity's 'parents' attribute has different visibility in the template and the solution. In the template repository 'parents' is declared as a private field with a getter/setter (encapsulated), while in the solution repository it is declared as a public field. This discrepancy is structural (visibility) and may confuse students about the intended access pattern (direct field access vs. using getters/setters) and about which style to follow when implementing or using the model.
issues.suggested_fix: Make the visibility consistent across template and solution. Prefer keeping 'parents' private with public getter/setter (as in the template) and update the solution to use the getter/setter, or (less recommended) update the template to match the solution and document the intention. Consistency avoids student confusion about whether to access the relation directly or via accessors.
